subject.title: opencode/opencode-go: catalog drifts from live gateway + models.dev (IDs, pricing, context; hybrid refresh)

question: Should OpenClaw’s bundled OpenCode Zen and Go plugins fetch models.dev metadata at runtime, or should they remain static catalogs refreshed through focused provider updates?
rationale: This choice establishes a long-lived external metadata authority and determines whether changing upstream pricing/context data can affect existing runtime behavior; it cannot be resolved safely from a one-model repair alone.

options.title: Approve a plugin-owned hybrid refresh
options.body: Define models.dev as a bounded metadata source behind gateway-ID availability, with static policy and offline fallback retained in each provider plugin.

options.title: Keep static catalogs only
options.body: Use focused refresh PRs and fixtures for verified gateway changes, avoiding a new runtime dependency on third-party catalog metadata.

options.title: Split the work
options.body: Land static fixes now and open a separately sponsored design issue for hybrid-refresh source contracts and lifecycle behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve a plugin-owned hybrid refresh
recommendation.body: Define models.dev as a bounded metadata source behind gateway-ID availability, with static policy and offline fallback retained in each provider plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent OpenCode catalog history and provider-boundary decisions make this the strongest available routing signal.
